title: BELMAR PRO DAY 1
description:
What's up NUB NATION!! Today we headed up to North New Jersey to surf in the Belmar Pro surfing contest. The waves were pretty small, but team Hyperflex was on for the dream!! The VLOG has been super fun to film lately & I am stoked on everything. Thank you NUB NATION for all the love & support!! - Love Ben
